firstPrinciple: Interatomic potentials are necessary and wrong in ways worth measuring; Lupine Science measures that error against published references and gates set in advance and publishes every verdict.
intendedReaders: reviewers who need claim status and provenance
observerPosture: Readers evaluating the program should start from the public evidence trail and the ledger.

layers.name: Error geometry
layers.question: Do prediction errors form stable low-dimensional structure across potentials, elements, properties, and structure families? (Open.)

layers.name: Sloppy-model structure
layers.question: Which stiff and sloppy directions explain model failure?

layers.name: Cross-MLIP transfer
layers.question: Do foundation MLIPs inherit, rotate, or escape the classical error geometry?

layers.name: Causal and statistical validity
layers.question: Which trends survive matched samples, bootstrap controls, stratification, and contamination checks?

layers.name: Claim lifecycle
layers.question: Which claims are Supported, Open, Failed, Abstained, Refuted by us, Self-corrected or Withdrawn?

layers.name: Formal specification
layers.question: Which arithmetic and stated inequalities behind published numbers can Lean 4 check? It does not check the physics, the reference data or the pipeline.

layers.name: Review-ready manuscripts
layers.question: Which advanced paper drafts are mature enough for human review but not yet submission-ready?

layers.name: Agentic research loop
layers.question: Can agents propose, test, broadcast, and record claims and their corrections without losing provenance?
